────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Retry fix 

Once a job's lease has expired while the worker is still backing off between attempts, what should happen to the retry 
that is already scheduled for the job after the original attempt fails?

❯ 1. Keep it (safety net)  
   Run the scheduled retry anyway   and log a warning AND s ill let the next lease holder run too. Lowest risk — you
     never lose a job even if the lease bookkeeping is wrong — but it may run twice.
  2. Suppress the duplicate
     Drop the scheduled retry when the lease has expired, so the new lease holder is the only runner. Cleaner
     history, but if the new holder crashed before it started (very short lease) the job is lost.
  3. Smart: suppress only if full
     Drop the retry only when a new lease holder has acknowledged the job; otherwise let the scheduled retry
     through. Best of both, but more state to get right.
  4. Type something.
